spec: fingerprint(secret, relationship) = lowercase hex of the first 16 bytes (32 hex characters) of HMAC-SHA256 with key = the UTF-8 bytes of the secret and message = the UTF-8 bytes of "feir-secret-alignment/v1:" + relationship.

The secret is the exact value the plane keys or compares with: nothing is trimmed here. A plane that trims its configured value before using it fingerprints the trimmed value; a bearer token is fingerprinted without its "Bearer " prefix.
An empty secret has no fingerprint: the plane omits the relationship (or reports an empty list) instead of fingerprinting the empty string.
A plane that accepts several values for one relationship (a rotation list) reports one fingerprint per value, in configuration order, without duplicates.
The relationship name is part of the message, so one secret used for two relationships has two different fingerprints and a fingerprint from one relationship cannot be replayed as another's.

The report is only served behind each plane's operator credential. A fingerprint lets someone who holds it test guesses for a LOW-ENTROPY secret offline, so it is only as private as the secret is strong: the secrets of this stack are generated (64 hex characters).

cases.name: hex secret as the stack generates them
surrounding whitespace is kept (the plane decides whether to trim)
